hunt.justification: The compromise of pub.dev packages allows for the exfiltration of high-value CI secrets and developer credentials via native build hooks. A negative result across the build estate is a critical assurance.

meta.name: Malicious Flutter Package Build Execution

related.reason: This hunt is specifically tuned for Flutter/Xcode/Gradle artifacts; generic hunts may miss these native hooks.

meta.analysis: A simple rule for elvynforge.xyz is noisy; the hunt correlates the resolution specifically back to the 'gradle' or 'xcode' build process and the local presence of specific package versions, providing a behavioral context rules lack.

coverage.reason: Not examined by this hunt; belongs to a separate hunt.

scenario.summary: A supply chain attack targeting the pub.dev ecosystem weaponized legitimate Flutter packages to inject malicious build-time hooks for Android and Apple platforms. The malware executes during development or CI builds, using obfuscated Gradle and Xcode build rules to fetch and execute remote shell scripts from C2 infrastructure.

meta.rationale: Target CI runners and macOS/Linux workstations where Flutter development occurs. Start with hosts appearing in hb_software_inventory.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has compromised a Flutter package maintainer to inject build-time RCE, resulting in developer or CI machines downloading malicious dependencies and beaconing to C2 during the build process.

hunt.name: Malicious Flutter Package Build Execution
hunt.description: This hunt targets a supply chain attack involving the pub.dev ecosystem. Malicious code was injected into legitimate Flutter packages (universal_file_viewer and surveyjs_flutter) specifically targeting build files like build.gradle and Xcode project files. This allows execution on developer machines and CI runners where high-value secrets reside. The hunt identifies affected package versions in local inventory, monitors for unauthorized build file modifications, and corroborates through DNS and HTTP activity filtered by build-system process attribution.

nodes.label: Find malicious package versions in inventory

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, install_path, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (instr(',' || '{{malicious_packages}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{malicious_versions}}' || ',', ',' || package_version || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0)
config.description: Identify hosts that have specifically compromised versions of the targeted Flutter packages.
config.expected_signal: Hosts with malicious package versions in their inventory. Silence suggests no managed installation of these versions.

nodes.label: Unauthorized modifications to sensitive build files

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, COUNT(*) AS modifications, MIN(time) AS first_mod FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{build_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%git%' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%vscode%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, file_name, process_name HAVING modifications < 10
config.description: Search for modifications to build configuration files occurring outside of expected version control patterns or by rare processes.
config.expected_signal: A rare process modifying build files. Legitimate CI tools or editors should be high frequency; injector activity is additive and rare.

primitive_config.label: Unauthorized modifications to sensitive build files
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, COUNT(*) AS modifications, MIN(time) AS first_mod FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{build_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%git%' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%vscode%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, file_name, process_name HAVING modifications < 10
